mapper.insert: /* CompanyProvisionMapper.copyAuthMenuFromTemplate */ INSERT INTO tb_syst_auth_menu ( CMPNY_CD, AUTH_CD, MENU_D_ID, USE_YN, INSERT_NO, INSERT_DATE, UPDATE_NO, UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT #{newCmpnyCd}, AUTH_CD, MENU_D_ID, USE_YN, #{gvUserCd}, NOW(), #{gvUserCd}, NOW() FROM tb_syst_auth_menu WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND AUTH_CD IN ('master', 'hr', 'safe', '99999') AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/* CompanyProvisionMapper.copyBaimValDFromTemplateRenumber */ INSERT INTO tb_baim_val_d ( CMPNY_CD, BAIM_VAL_CD, BAIM_VAL_D_CD, BAIM_VAL_D_NM, SORT_IDX, USE_YN, VAL_D_INFO_1, VAL_D_INFO_2, VAL_D_DESC, INSERT_NO, INSERT_DATE, UPDATE_NO, UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT #{newCmpnyCd}, BAIM_VAL_CD, LPAD(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BAIM_VAL_CD ORDER BY SORT_IDX), 5, '0'), BAIM_VAL_D_NM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BAIM_VAL_CD ORDER BY SORT_IDX), USE_YN, VAL_D_INFO_1, VAL_D_INFO_2, VAL_D_DESC, #{gvUserCd}, NOW(), #{gvUserCd}, NOW() FROM tb_baim_val_d WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND BAIM_VAL_CD != 'COM005'

/* CompanyProvisionMapper.copyBaimValDPreserveAuth */ INSERT INTO tb_baim_val_d ( CMPNY_CD, BAIM_VAL_CD, BAIM_VAL_D_CD, BAIM_VAL_D_NM, SORT_IDX, USE_YN, VAL_D_INFO_1, VAL_D_INFO_2, VAL_D_DESC, INSERT_NO, INSERT_DATE, UPDATE_NO, UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT #{newCmpnyCd}, BAIM_VAL_CD, BAIM_VAL_D_CD, BAIM_VAL_D_NM, SORT_IDX, USE_YN, VAL_D_INFO_1, VAL_D_INFO_2, VAL_D_DESC, #{gvUserCd}, NOW(), #{gvUserCd}, NOW() FROM tb_baim_val_d WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM005'

/* CompanyProvisionMapper.seedCmmSeqFromBaimValD */ INSERT INTO tb_cmm_seq ( CMPNY_CD, SEQ_KEY, CURR_VAL ) SELECT #{newCmpnyCd}, BAIM_VAL_CD, MAX(CAST(BAIM_VAL_D_CD AS UNSIGNED)) FROM tb_baim_val_d WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{newCmpnyCd} AND BAIM_VAL_CD != 'COM005' GROUP BY BAIM_VAL_CD

/* CompanyProvisionMapper.seedSystemLeaveTypes */ INSERT INTO TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT ( CMPNY_CD, LEAVE_CD, LEAVE_NO, LEAVE_NM, LEAVE_TYPE, GRANT_TYPE, PAID_TYPE, LEAVE_NATURE_TYPE, USE_YN, SYSTEM_YN, INSERT_NO, INSERT_DATE ) SELECT #{newCmpnyCd}, S.LEAVE_CD, S.LEAVE_CD, S.LEAVE_NM, '02', '01', '01', S.NATURE, 'Y', 'Y', #{gvUserCd}, NOW() FROM ( SELECT 'SYS_ANNUAL' AS LEAVE_CD, '연차' AS LEAVE_NM, '01' AS NATURE UNION ALL SELECT 'SYS_MONTHLY' , '월차' , '01' UNION ALL SELECT 'SYS_TENURE_BONUS' , '근속가산 연차' , '01' UNION ALL SELECT 'SYS_PREGRANT' , '일괄선부여 연차' , '01' UNION ALL SELECT 'SYS_PROMOTION' , '사용촉진 연차' , '01' UNION ALL SELECT 'SYS_BIRTHDAY' , '생일 안식휴가' , '02' ) S WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT T WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = #{newCmpnyCd} AND T.LEAVE_CD = S.LEAVE_CD )

/* CompanyProvisionMapper.seedDefaultLeavePolicy */ INSERT INTO TB_LEAVE_POLICY ( CMPNY_CD, POLICY_PRESET, AXIS1_GRANT_BASE, AXIS3_FIRST_YEAR_METHOD, AXIS3_PREGRANT_YN, AXIS4_PRORATE_ROUNDING, AXIS5_TENURE_MODE, AXIS5_START_YEAR, AXIS5_INTERVAL, AXIS5_MAX_DAYS, AXIS6_VALIDITY_MONTHS, AXIS7_USE_PROMOTION, APRV_USE_YN, USE_YN, APPLY_FROM_DATE, INSERT_NO, INSERT_DATE, UPDATE_NO, UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{cmpnyCd}, 'LEGAL_DEFAULT', 'HIRE_DATE', 'MONTHLY_ONLY', 'N', 'CEIL', 'LEGAL', 3, 2, 25, 12, 'Y', 'Y', 'Y', #{applyFromDate}, #{insertNo}, NOW(), #{insertNo}, NOW() )

/* CompanyProvisionMapper.copyCommonRiskTypeFromTemplate */ INSERT INTO TB_RISK_TYPE ( CMPNY_CD, RISK_TYPE_CD, RISK_TYPE_NM, SITE_CD, PROCESS_CD, RISK_TYPE_DESC, USE_YN, INSERT_NO, INSERT_DATE, UPDATE_NO, UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT #{newCmpnyCd} , R.RISK_TYPE_CD , R.RISK_TYPE_NM , NULL , NEW_C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD , R.RISK_TYPE_DESC , 'Y', #{gvUserCd}, NOW(), #{gvUserCd}, NOW() FROM TB_RISK_TYPE R JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D SRC_C ON SRC_C.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND SRC_C.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND SRC_C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = R.PROCESS_CD JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D NEW_C ON NEW_C.CMPNY_CD = #{newCmpnyCd} AND NEW_C.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND NEW_C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM = SRC_C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (R.SITE_CD IS NULL OR R.SITE_CD = '')

/* CompanyProvisionMapper.copyCommonRiskHazardFromTemplate */ INSERT INTO TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD ( CMPNY_CD, RISK_TYPE_CD, HAZARD_CD, HAZARD_NM, SITE_CD, HAZARD_DESC, USE_YN, INSERT_NO, INSERT_DATE, UPDATE_NO, UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT #{newCmpnyCd}, H.RISK_TYPE_CD, H.HAZARD_CD, H.HAZARD_NM, NULL, H.HAZARD_DESC , 'Y', #{gvUserCd}, NOW(), #{gvUserCd}, NOW() FROM TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD H JOIN TB_RISK_TYPE NEW_R ON NEW_R.CMPNY_CD = #{newCmpnyCd} AND NEW_R.RISK_TYPE_CD = H.RISK_TYPE_CD WHERE H.CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND IFNULL(H.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND (H.SITE_CD IS NULL OR H.SITE_CD = '')
